title: Waystones issue #1144: Unable to edit names in UI

text:
[issue by uwuboi273]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

Every time I even attempt to edit a name the game completely crashes.

### Logs

https://mclo.gs/c4BHmKR

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
`Veinminer Client` is including an incompatible version of `fabric-permissions-api` for a newer version of Minecraft. Which is funny because on newer versions of Minecraft, the version they include is also incompatible, but instead for older versions of Minecraft.

The only way around this is reporting the issue to Veinminer Client, and either removing that mod or manually removing the wrong fabric-permissions-api jar from the Veinminer Client .jar.
